verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Datalab statement, policy, or setting about whether customer documents are used to train models, and no opt-out control. The nearest items are adjacent: a paid on-prem/air-gapped Enterprise deployment aimed at data-privacy needs, and a BAA/DPA on the Team plan. Neither documents a no-training commitment or opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
